mentions.name: Code of Honor
mentions.description: A personal blog rebuilt using sandvault and Claude to replace WordPress, featuring search functionality and automatic syndication of articles to Mastodon, BlueSky, and Twitter.
mentions.source_excerpt: I'm using sandvault+Claude to rebuild my personal blog, Code of Honor [1], because I got tired of WordPress. The site includes search functionality, and articles are automatically syndicated to Mastadon, BlueSky, and Twitter.
